mapper.select: select id, type_code, value, label, sort, status, color, remark from sys_dict_data order by type_code, sort asc, id asc
select id, type_code, value, label, sort, status, color, remark from sys_dict_data where type_code = #{typeCode} and status = 1 order by sort asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dict_data(type_code, value, label, sort, status, color, remark) values (#{typeCode}, #{value}, #{label}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{color}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_dict_data set type_code = #{typeCode}, value = #{value}, label = #{label}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, color = #{color}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
